# CLI command coverage

All public command families and subcommands are enumerated here. This is a presentation review, not an execution matrix for every flag combination, operating system, model or provider. Only **real PTY** entries claim command execution.

Only opencode install/uninstall outcomes are executed in the command captures. Other target-specific and platform-specific file formats are covered by source/tests, not by these PTY captures.

MCP stdout remains a protocol stream; no human-facing screenshot is invented for it. Still images cannot verify timing, readiness or byte-stream contracts; those require tests.

| Family | Command / interaction | Evidence | Screenshots | Scope and limits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
